subject: English
title: Meow
subtitle: Who said 'Meow'?
hero_picture: A puppy sleeping on a mat near a sofa in a living room while a striped cat peeps from behind a curtain.

sections.heading: Who said 'Meow'?
text: The puppy was sleeping on a mat near the sofa.
He raised his head and looked around. Nobody was there.
sections.caption: Who said 'Meow'?
sections.picture: A puppy lifting its head from a mat in a living room, listening.

sections.heading: Searching
text: 'Who is there?' He looked under the bed.
He climbed onto the window and saw a rooster in the yard.
sections.caption: Searching
sections.picture: A puppy looking under a bed while a cat hides on top of a cupboard.

sections.heading: Rooster, dog and bee
text: 'Can you say Meow?' 'I only say Cock-a-doodle-doo.'
The dog in the kennel said, 'Bow, wow!' and got angry.
A honeybee said 'Zzz' and stung the puppy's nose. Ayyo!
sections.caption: Rooster, dog and bee
sections.picture: A puppy asking a big colourful rooster in a yard, a dog kennel behind.

sections.heading: Into the pond
text: The puppy jumped into a pond.
The frog said, 'Croak, croak! Frogs can only croak.'
The puppy went home, wet and sad.
sections.caption: Into the pond
sections.picture: A wet puppy in a pond and a green frog leaping into the water.

sections.heading: The cat!
text: 'Meow!' He saw a fat cat on the table.
'Bow wow!' The cat hissed, scratched his ear and ran away.
sections.caption: The cat!
sections.picture: A striped cat arching its back and hissing at a surprised puppy in a room.

rhyme: Zzz, says the bee, croak says the frog,
activity: Make the sounds: a cat, a dog, a rooster, a frog and a bee. Let your friend guess the animal.
summary: Each animal makes its own sound; the puppy finally found that the cat said 'Meow'.

questions.explanation: He was sleeping on a mat near the sofa.
